description: Places a real test call to a confirmed phone — the same call as on an outage — and spends one call from the balance (`call_balance_get`). Notification rules and project settings do not apply: only the phone itself is checked. Returns `call_id`; the outcome usually arrives within a minute, read it with `notification_phone_test_result`. 409 — the phone is not confirmed, no calls are left, or the previous test call is still going; 429 — too many test calls to this phone; 403 — calls are not available on the plan.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: notification_phone_test
title: Place a test call to a phone
